There are many ways to make Thunderbird work with your accessibility needs.

__TOC__

=Keyboard Support=
Thunderbird has extensive keyboard shortcuts to allow you to perform tasks inside Thunderbird faster. See the [https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/keyboard-shortcuts-thunderbird Keyboard Shortcuts] support page for more information.

If you use a screen reader, there are specific keyboard actions that work with your screen reader. We are updating our support documentation to list these keyboard actions for screen readers.

=Screen Readers=
<!--Documentation for keyboard actions that can be used within our [comment] this sentence ends abruptly, commenting it out as it appears to repeat above sentence-->
==Supported Screen Readers By Operating System==
===Windows===
On Windows, the following screen readers have been tested to work with Thunderbird.
*[http://www.nvaccess.org/ NVDA] (free, donation-based)
*[https://www.freedomscientific.com/products/software/jaws/ Jaws] (commercial)
The following screen readers have not been thoroughly tested with Thunderbird, but are available on Windows.
*[https://support.microsoft.com/windows/complete-guide-to-narrator-e4397a0d-ef4f-b386-d8ae-c172f109bdb1 Narrator] (Windows default)
*[http://www.gwmicro.com/Window-Eyes/ Windows Eyes] (commercial)

===Mac===
The following screen readers have not been thoroughly tested with Thunderbird, but are available on macOS.
*[https://www.apple.com/accessibility/vision/ VoiceOver] (macOS default)

===Linux===
The following screen readers have not been thoroughly tested with Thunderbird, but are available on Linux operating systems.
*[https://help.gnome.org/users/orca/stable/ Orca] (GNOME default)

=Font Size=
==115 and greater==
There have been significant updates in 115 to improve the ability to adjust the font size throughout the application.

Here's how to change the font size:
* Click {menu ≡} > {menu Font Size} and then click the {button +} icon to increase the font size or click the {button -} icon to decrease the font size. 

==102==
In older versions, the following add-on was recommended for increasing the font size.
*[https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/addon/theme-font-size-changer-fixed/ Theme Font & Size Changer (fixed) add-on]
For instructions on how to install add-ons, see [[Installing an Add-on in Thunderbird]].
